title: Youthful Korean Egg Bowl
description: A fresh, bouncy‑qq one‑pot Korean rice bowl with a smoky note from binchotan charcoal, eggs, and optional serrano ham.

ingredients.name: binchotan charcoal
ingredients.notes: to be placed in pan for smoky aroma

instructions: Place the binchotan charcoal disc in a small pan and preheat over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir until the rice is heated through and slightly toasted.
Whisk together the gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper in a bowl.
Pour the sauce mixture over the rice and stir to coat evenly.
Fold in the chopped scallions and optional serrano ham strips.
Create two wells in the rice and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the pan with a lid and cook until the egg whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 3 minutes.
Serve the bowl immediately, garnishing with extra scallions if desired.
